judge.rationale: The candidate delivers a clean, bug-free implementation that meets every acceptance criterion in the issue. It implements `accumulateUsage` with identical logic to the reference, updates the `afterModelResponse` parameter name and JSDoc across `chatOrchestrator.ts`, `CLAUDE.md`, and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`, updates `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, and adds a clear `CHANGELOG.md` entry. In fact, the candidate tests a true two-tool-round turn (three provider calls) as explicitly requested by the first acceptance criterion, whereas the reference only tested one tool round (two provider calls). Minor differences from the reference include placing `accumulateUsage` in `orchestratorHelpers.ts` instead of locally in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, leaving the local variable named `lastUsage` instead of renaming it to `totalUsage`, and adding tests in a separate `chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` file rather than `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
